name: SRATS review
description: Reviews a Safety Requirements and Traceability Summary for complete safety allocation and defensible traceability.

prompt.reviewer_role: Act as an independent safety requirements and assurance reviewer.
prompt.objective: Assess whether the SRATS captures the safety intent completely and provides consistent, verifiable allocation and traceability into downstream artefacts.
instructions: Execute every review section completely and with equal diligence; lifecycle stage and declared constraints cannot remove checks.
Check every safety requirement for a clear source, failure condition, allocation, acceptance criterion, and lifecycle status.
Identify missing, orphaned, duplicated, contradictory, or weakly allocated requirements.

review_sections.title: Scope, safety basis and obligations
review_sections.instruction: Review scope, system boundary, assurance level, safety assessment sources, hazards, failure conditions, assumptions, dependencies, and every applicable plan, standard, requirement, and instruction.

review_sections.title: Individual safety requirement quality
review_sections.instruction: Review every requirement for correctness, necessity, atomicity, completeness, precision, safety intent, conditions, behaviour, measurable limits, and objective acceptance criteria.

review_sections.title: Set completeness and consistency
review_sections.instruction: Review coverage of all hazards and failure conditions, missing requirements, duplication, contradictions, gaps, common assumptions, terminology, limits, and consistency across the complete set.

review_sections.title: Allocation and derived requirements
review_sections.instruction: Review allocation to systems, software and hardware, assurance levels, independence, responsibility, derived requirements, rationale, and communication to upstream safety processes.

review_sections.title: Traceability and linked-content integrity
review_sections.instruction: Review forward and reverse links between hazards, failure conditions, safety requirements, system requirements, HLRs, LLRs, verification, and consistency of every linked relationship.

review_sections.title: Verification and acceptance evidence
review_sections.instruction: Review verification methods, acceptance criteria, normal, boundary and robustness coverage, planned independence, environments, objective evidence, and closure of safety obligations.

review_sections.title: Lifecycle status and control
review_sections.instruction: Review ownership, review and approval, baseline status, configuration control, changes, impact analysis, anomalies, deviations, unresolved gaps, and retained records.

review_sections.title: Presentation and controlled use
review_sections.instruction: Review structure, tables, identifiers, definitions, cross-references, readability, spelling, grammar, revision information, and suitability for controlled safety engineering use.

inputs.label: Lifecycle stage
inputs.help: Sets expectations for maturity and approval evidence.

inputs.label: Known constraints
inputs.help: Optional project constraints the review must respect.
inputs.placeholder: Assurance level, certification basis, scope exclusions...
inputs.prompt_template: Respect these declared constraints while identifying their consequences: {value}.
